### Non-obvious Logic

1. **"Person 2 of 9"** — This count derives from whatever list/smart list/filter the user navigated from (e.g., a smart list showing hot seller LP leads). FUB keeps track of position so the user can keyboard-navigate through the list without returning to the list view. The arrows and keyboard shortcuts are a power-user feature for high-volume lead follow-up workflows.

2. **Email "archived" subject + `_pxl=` URLs** — These automation emails have "archived" as their subject, indicating these were sent via an automated drip/campaign and the body contains a campaign-tracking pixel URL (ryan-realty.com?_pxl=...). The "2 opens" badge is derived from email open-tracking pixel reads. The "View campaign email" link opens the actual archived email content (since the body preview only shows the tracking URL, not the real rendered content).

3. **"via automation" label** — FUB distinguishes emails sent manually by an agent from those sent by an automated action plan or campaign. This metadata appears in the timeline header row as "via automation" when the sending was system-triggered.

4. **Task overdue state** — The due date displayed in red/orange indicates the task is past due. FUB applies a visual overdue state when `due_at < now()` and `completed = false`. This is a common UI pattern to surface urgency.

5. **Social Profile data (age 76, gender Female, Bend OR)** — This data is NOT manually entered; it is automatically enriched by FUB's built-in data enrichment service that matches the contact's email against third-party data providers. The LinkedIn/Google links are auto-generated search/profile links.

6. **"Hot seller LP lead" task** — The task text includes a full address (62285 Deer Trail Rd, Bend, OR 97701, USA), suggesting this task was auto-created by a lead capture automation (e.g., the seller landing page webhook) that appended the address from the lead form submission into the task title. This is a common FUB webhook → task creation pattern.

7. **"Web Inquiry Option 01" automation** — This is a named automation sequence in FUB (action plan) that was enrolled for this contact when they submitted a web inquiry form. It is currently in a "Running" state (has more steps to execute). The pause button allows temporarily halting the sequence for this specific contact.

8. **AgentFire FUB Widget** — This is a third-party CRM widget installed by AgentFire (a real estate website/CRM platform). It surfaces data from the AgentFire system inside the FUB contact record. Rebuilt as an iframe-embedded or API-powered third-party widget panel.

9. **Email compose pre-populates the signature** — The email compose area auto-injects the logged-in broker's email signature block (with photo, contact info, logo, links, and legal disclaimer) below the cursor. This is a FUB account-level setting where each agent configures their signature once. The signature renders as HTML in the WYSIWYG body editor.

10. **Template quick-picks** — "Introduction", "Follow Up", "Still Buying", "Nurture Lead" are system-level or account-level email templates pre-created in FUB. Clicking one inserts the template body (pre-written text) and potentially sets the subject line. The "+ Custom" option opens the full template library. These are not AI-generated — they are static stored templates.

11. **"Seen 17 days ago" in Activity** — This is the last time an activity of any kind was recorded for this contact (email sent/received, note added, call logged, etc.). It provides a quick at-a-glance staleness indicator for the contact relationship.

12. **Reply/Forward/More actions on timeline events** — Reply opens a new email compose targeted as a reply to that specific email thread. Forward opens compose with the original email quoted. "More" opens a contextual dropdown with options like "Print", "Copy email link", "Delete from timeline", "Mark as unread" [INFERRED from FUB conventions].
